name: Boomerang
description: A hand-carved hardwood boomerang. Lil Artie's signature weapon — throw it and it always comes back.

name: Dagger
description: A short, balanced blade for close-quarters combat. Fast combo attacks.

name: Whip
description: A long leather whip. Can disarm enemies, crack targets at range, and latch onto swing points.

name: Spear
description: A reach weapon found in the coastal ruins. Unlocked after completing Chapter 2.

name: Stone Sling
description: A simple but deadly ranged tool. Unlimited ammo from gathered river stones.
